architecture: MobileNetV3-Small shared encoder + U-Net ROI segmentation + 9-class classification
checkpoint: best_model.pth (training-run source; not included in the browser package)

preprocessing.page: Grayscale, replicated to RGB and ImageNet-normalized, letterbox 256x256
preprocessing.roi: Grayscale, replicated to RGB and ImageNet-normalized, letterbox 224x224
preprocessing.all_labels: Every image is converted to grayscale before page segmentation and ROI classification.

outputs.embedding_prototypes: prototypes.json; normalized 576D class means; compare with cosine similarity

rejection.rule: reject if top softmax confidence OR maximum prototype cosine is below its threshold

suggested_thresholds.basis: User-selected defaults below 0.40; not calibrated against non-document negatives.

rejection.caveat: Lower thresholds make acceptance easier. Validation contains document images only, so these defaults do not establish reliable rejection of non-documents.
rejection.basis: Both default rejection thresholds are 0.39 and adjustable.

validation.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU
